deck_title: Borda-Kirchhoff C_c = A_jet / A_orifice = 1/(1+u) vena contracta orifice discharge law vs naive C_c=1 plug-orifice rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Jean-Charles de Borda (1766) & Gustav Kirchhoff (1869) free-streamline orifice vena-contracta discharge law (equating hydrostatic wall pressure deficit rho*g*h*A_0 to outgoing jet momentum flux rho*A_jet*(2*g*h) so contraction coefficient C_c = A_jet / A_0 = 1 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 for Borda’s re-entrant mouthpiece, locking Q_active / Q_Borda = 1.0000x across all 17 stations u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive full-orifice plug discharge shader (C_c = 1.0000, which overestimates jet cross-section and volumetric discharge by 1 / C_c = 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stations) and 64-streamline Helmholtz-Kirchhoff hodograph momentum quadrature.
